USE nyc_taxi_discovery;

SELECT 
taxi_zone.borough , COUNT(1) AS number_of_trips
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'trip_data_green_delta/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS trip_data
JOIN 
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'taxi_zone.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        FIRSTROW = 2,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
        ROWTERMINATOR = '\n'
    )
    WITH (
        locationid SMALLINT 1,
        borough VARCHAR(15) 2,
        zone VARCHAR(50) 3,
        service_zone VARCHAR(15) 4
    ) AS taxi_zone
ON trip_data.PULocationID = taxi_zone.locationid
GROUP BY taxi_zone.borough
ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC
